titel: Earwigs Don't Crawl Into Your Ears

beats.say: Earwigs do *not* crawl into your ears to lay eggs.
But Rudi heard they burrow into your *brain.* He hasn't slept since.
So Rudi sleeps in giant *earmuffs.* The earwig doesn't care. It's outside, eating *flowers.*
Earmuffs felt risky, so Rudi got a *space helmet.* The earwig? Busy eating *aphids.*
The name comes from an old European *superstition.*
Virginia Tech says it plainly: this belief is totally *unfounded.*
And those *pincers?* Too weak to really hurt you.
Earwig moms are rare among insects. She guards up to *fifty* eggs, and licks them clean.
Tip: hang a flower pot with *straw* upside down. Earwigs move in, and you can move them out.
So tonight, Rudi can finally sleep... because
